$comment: One entry per vendored Pi package. packages/<dir> holds the exact published tarball contents; local changes live in patches/<dir>/*.patch.

decide.review: Written for this setup (plan modeles-routage, phase B; 0.2.0: reads the gateway from Pi, no launcher). No dependencies, no install scripts. Only network call: POST <magpie baseUrl>/systemone (group/decide) with the key of Pi's `magpie` provider, resolved through ctx.modelRegistry (models.json + auth.json). Reads and writes no file.
